typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CONCEPT as integer (),
	CurrentFileName as string (),
	DataSource as string (),
	DB as string (),
	DestVariable as string (),
	ErrorFolder as string (),
	Excel as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	Rowcount as integer (),
	SrcFolder as string (),
	User_ID as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		VALUE as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		AGE as string,
		ADDRESS as string,
		CITY as string,
		COUNTY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP as string,
		PHONE as string,
		PLAN as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		POPCATEGORYCODE as string,
		GRGR_CK as string,
		GRGR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource	source(output(
		subscriber_id as string,
		cid as integer,
		group_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT        subscriber_id, cid,group_id  FROM            CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE WITH (NOLOCK)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPforCIDLKPTABLE
ExcelSource derive(CONCEPT_ID = $CONCEPT,
		UPDATE_DATE = toDate(toString((substring(toString($CurrentFileName), toInteger(16), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString($CurrentFileName), toInteger(20), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString($CurrentFileName), toInteger(22), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		SYSTEM_DATE = notConvertedectfunctiondategetdatef(),
		SOURCE_NAME = 'FAST TRACK DUALS',
		MEMBERNUMBER = iif(substring(toString(reverse(MEMBERNUMBER)), toInteger(1), toInteger(2)) == '00', reverse(substring(toString(reverse(MEMBERNUMBER)), toInteger(3), toInteger(100))), MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LKPforCIDLKPTABLE lookup(GRGR_ID == group_id && MEMBERNUMBER == subscriber_id,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPforCID
LKPforCID split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LKPforCIDIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LKPforCIDIsMatch@NotMatch select(mapColumn(
		CID = cid,
		CONCEPT_ID = CONCEPT_ID,
		UPDATE_DATE = UPDATE_DATE,
		SYSTEM_DATE = SYSTEM_DATE,
		SOURCE_NAME = SOURCE_NAME,
		MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER,
		VALUE = VALUE,
		LAST_NAME = LAST_NAME,
		FIRST_NAME = FIRST_NAME,
		AGE = AGE,
		ADDRESS = ADDRESS,
		CITY = CITY,
		COUNTY = COUNTY,
		STATE = STATE,
		ZIP = ZIP,
		PHONE = PHONE,
		PLAN = PLAN,
		PRODUCT = PRODUCT,
		POPCATEGORYCODE = POPCATEGORYCODE,
		GRGR_CK = GRGR_CK,
		GRGR_ID = GRGR_ID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPforCIDREFORMAT
LKPforCIDIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		ZIP as string,
		GRGR_CK as string,
		PHONE as string,
		MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		STATE as string,
		VALUE as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		PLAN as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		CITY as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		ADDRESS as string,
		POPCATEGORYCODE as string,
		AGE as string,
		COUNTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ZIP,
		GRGR_CK,
		PHONE,
		MEMBERNUMBER,
		STATE,
		VALUE,
		LAST_NAME,
		PLAN,
		FIRST_NAME,
		GRGR_ID,
		CITY,
		PRODUCT,
		ADDRESS,
		POPCATEGORYCODE,
		AGE,
		COUNTY)) ~> FlatFileDestination
LKPforCIDREFORMAT derive(SUBSCRIBER_ID = toString(MEMBERNUMBER),
		CONCEPT_VALUE = toString(VALUE),
		SOURCE_NAME = toString(SOURCE_NAME)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		SYSTEM_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SOURCE_NAME as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SYSTEM_DATE,
		CONCEPT_ID,
		UPDATE_DATE,
		SOURCE_NAME,
		CONCEPT_VALUE,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		CID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
